This template creates a minimal video chat between the visitors of the site. It uses the [Peersockets API](/docs/api/apis/nomad.peersockets) to set up a WebRTC video call between users. Traffic is encrypted so that only users who possess the site's URL can read it.

(Note: this is a simple demo and won't work with more than 2 users.)
